description: Create or edit a paragraph style without applying it (Paragraph Style Options): name, Based On, Next Style, Reset To Base, and its character, indents and spacing, keep, hyphenation, justification, drop cap, rule, span column, shading, border and bullets and numbering attributes

applyToSelection.description: Apply Style to Selection: also apply the style to the selected text

attributes.description: Paragraph attributes to set, by InDesign property name

autoLeading.description: Auto leading in percent of the font size

bulletsTextAfter.description: Text after the bullet or number, such as "^t"

composer.description: Composer name, such as "Adobe Paragraph Composer"

dropCapStyle.description: Character style for the drop cap

emitCss.description: Emit CSS for the style on export

fillColor.description: Character colour: a swatch name or #RRGGBB (A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch))

fillTint.description: Character colour tint in percent (-1 = none)

fontStyle.description: Font style name, such as Bold or Italic

hyphenateWordsLongerThan.description: Hyphenate words with at least N letters

includeClass.description: Include the class in exported HTML

keepAllLinesTogether.description: Keep all lines in the paragraph together

keepFirstLines.description: Keep the first N lines together

keepLastLines.description: Keep the last N lines together

paragraphBorderBottomLineWeight.description: Paragraph border bottom weight in points

paragraphBorderColor.description: Paragraph border colour (A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch))

paragraphBorderLeftLineWeight.description: Paragraph border left weight in points

paragraphBorderRightLineWeight.description: Paragraph border right weight in points

paragraphBorderTopLineWeight.description: Paragraph border top weight in points

paragraphShadingColor.description: Paragraph shading colour (A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch))

ruleAboveColor.description: Rule above colour (A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch))

ruleAboveLeftIndent.description: Rule above left indent in mm

ruleAboveRightIndent.description: Rule above right indent in mm

ruleBelowColor.description: Rule below colour (A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch))

ruleBelowLeftIndent.description: Rule below left indent in mm

ruleBelowRightIndent.description: Rule below right indent in mm

spanSplitColumnCount.description: Columns to span or split into: a number, or "all"

splitDocument.description: Split the EPUB document at this style

strokeColor.description: Character stroke colour: a swatch name or #RRGGBB (A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch))

tracking.description: Tracking in thousandths of an em

basedOn.description: Based On: the parent paragraph style: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

create.description: Create the style when it does not exist yet

group.description: Style group path for a new style, such as "Headings" or "Body/Lists" (groups are created as needed). Without it, a "Group/Style" name puts the style in that group

nextStyle.description: Next Style: the paragraph style for the paragraph that follows: a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

resetToBase.description: Reset To Base: make the style match its Based On style before applying attributes

style.description: The paragraph style to edit (or to create, with create: true): a style name, or "Group/Style" for a style inside a style group

name: set_paragraph_style
title: Set Paragraph Style
